project.name: Board Item Optimizer
project.description: Analyze a game board and the currently available items, then recommend the best item and target position to maximize expected rewards or explored cells.

rules: Rewards are randomly distributed across the board.
The board ends immediately when all rewards have been found.

After a certain amount of time, a random cell may be revealed automatically. Revealing a cell means determining whether it contains a reward. Once revealed, the cell is no longer affected by item effects.
Items can be obtained over time, and each item has a different effect.

unknown.description: The reward status has not been determined.

reward_found.description: A reward has already been confirmed.

no_reward.description: The cell has already been checked and contains no reward.

Special Boom.multiplier_condition: Only newly discovered rewards receive the 2x reward. Rewards already revealed before using Special Boom are not doubled.

effect.description: Automatically reveals every cell containing a reward.

item_inventory.description: Items can be used multiple times. The available quantity increases over time, so there is no fixed initial or maximum quantity.

reward_probability_model.description: At the beginning, all eligible unknown cells have the same probability of containing a reward.

dynamic_update.description: Each revealed result changes the reward probability of the remaining unknown cells.

reward_probability_model.future_extension: Support non-uniform probability models learned from observed gameplay data.

item_effect_rules.common: Already revealed cells do not receive item effects.
item_effect_rules.area_3x3: A target cell affects all unknown cells within one cell of the target in both x and y directions. Out-of-bounds cells are ignored.
item_effect_rules.lazer_x: Affects every unknown cell in the same row.
item_effect_rules.lazer_y: Affects every unknown cell in the same column.
item_effect_rules.gunpowder_barrel: A random eligible unknown cell becomes the center of the 3x3 effect.
item_effect_rules.key: Reveals all reward-containing cells and immediately ends the board.

secondary_goals: Maximize probability of finding at least one reward.
Maximize probability of completing the board.

single_action.description: Find the best target position for one selected item.
single_action.method: Enumerate all valid target cells and evaluate each candidate.

multi_action.description: Optimize item order and target positions across multiple future actions.

maximize_expected_rewards.description: Maximize the expected number of newly obtained rewards.

maximize_explored_cells.description: Maximize the expected number of newly revealed cells.

maximize_completion_probability.description: Maximize the probability of completing the board.

Gunpowder Barrel.evaluation: Expected value over all possible random centers.

Key.evaluation: Decide whether using the Key now is better than continuing with other items.

state_transition: Select an item and target according to the item rules.
Update cell states and remaining rewards.

image_analysis.goal: Convert a screenshot into the structured board state used by the optimizer.
pipeline: Separate board contents from UI elements.
implementation_order: Optional object detection model if necessary

development_phases.name: Board Model
tasks: Support unknown, reward_found, and no_reward states.

development_phases.name: Integration
tasks: Connect screenshot input to Board State.
Overlay recommendations on the original image.

initial_codex_task.goal: Build the Board Simulator and Item Optimizer before implementing image recognition.
first_milestone: Evaluate random-center expected values for Gunpowder Barrel.
Evaluate Key as a decision instead of a position.
